name: Felhound Brain
summary: A Felhound Brain is a demon part sought in Desolace for Reagents for Reclaimers Inc. Kreldig Ungor gathers them with other materials for a mage’s experiments.

sections.title: A Mage’s Reagents
sections.body: Near Mannoroc Coven, Ley Hunters, Mage Hunters, and Mana Eaters carry the brains Kreldig Ungor seeks. He asks for ten alongside Nether Wings and Doomwarder Blood, the final group of materials for Reagents for Reclaimers Inc. The work brings you against demons in a land where centaur hold much of the country.

faq.q: What is a Felhound Brain for?
faq.answer: Kreldig Ungor needs ten Felhound Brains for Reagents for Reclaimers Inc., where they join Nether Wings and Doomwarder Blood as materials for a mage’s experiments.
Ley Hunters, Mage Hunters, and Mana Eaters in Desolace carry Felhound Brains.

faq.q: Where can I find the felhounds?
faq.answer: The felhounds are near Mannoroc Coven in southern Desolace, beyond the Kodo Graveyard.
Kreldig Ungor asks for the Felhound Brains as part of the materials for Reagents for Reclaimers Inc.

angles.text: Kreldig Ungor gathers Felhound Brains and other demon materials for a mage’s experiments.
